away.summary: The Sharks (7-9-1) are sixth in the Pacific Division and have lost three straight games, holding a players-only meeting after a 7-2 loss to the Kings. They rank 28th in goals per game (2.53) and tied for 27th in goals-against per game (3.53). Alexander Wennberg remains out after missing the past eight games, while Nolan Allan and Filip Bystedt are scratched in the projected lineup.

home.summary: The Wild (11-3-3) are missing five players to injury, including defensemen Brock Faber and Jared Spurgeon, who will not play this weekend, and goaltender Filip Gustavsson, who is recovering from offseason surgery. Marcus and Nick Foligno practiced and participated in the morning skate but will not play and could return Saturday. The team held an optional morning skate ahead of the game.
